verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI documents 'agent delegation' (one agent handing off to another and regaining control) and durable execution across steps, which is a basic form of multi-agent composition, but the evidence pack has no mention of an explicit graph/workflow builder, branching logic, loop constructs, or parallel-step execution primitives. Missing for 10: explicit graph/workflow DSL, branching/conditional routing, loop constructs, parallel step execution, and independent confirmation of these features working in practice.
